name: npc-fields
description: Do a setup entry's undocumented fields reach the live NPCEntry? Bare vs cloned vs shipped, same map, same frame.
_comment: No 'setup' block on purpose. Slot 4 must be a byte-copy of slot 0 with two
fields overwritten, and a declared edit cannot express that -- it writes
template and position onto whatever the slot already holds, which for an
empty slot is zeros. Declaring it produced two BARE enemies and a probe
whose comments described a control that did not exist (D123).
